verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions online eVisa access and identity verification through the 'UK Immigration: ID Check app'. Nothing documents a sign-in path built on credential MFA that an authorized human can complete remotely. The ID Check app is an identity-verification step, not a credential-MFA login, so no documented capability matches this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
